name: Yu Zhe Zhi Meng：Ling Shi Jiang Zhi
source: Years ago, Phil was taken from a war-torn city to a distant village by a traveling witch. As the village's problem child, only one childhood friend was willing to stick by him. Then one day, everything changed when Phil met a mysterious girl who had lost all her memories and ended up in the village. This encounter set in motion a fate tied to his past. To uncover the truth about Zero Point City, the three of them decided to head to the Magic University, and the story of the boy becoming a traveler was just beginning...
